products.name: Overlapping Doors - 823mm x 801mm
description: The Overlapping Doors are a must-have for Skips and Rolonoff containers, offering protection from water damage. With two lids that overlap, these doors also come equipped with 2 handle slots for easy opening and closing, along with 3 hinges for added strength. Plus, the patented CCE lock ensures maximum security.
Normally used as a watertight pair of overlapping doors.
